en: Color postcard view of a busy urban square filled with 1950s–1960s cars, buses and trams. In the foreground stands a large statue of a man on a pedestal, looking out over the traffic. Behind it are modernist and Art Deco style office buildings and department stores with rounded corners and extensive glass, and in the distance several turreted, historic-looking buildings with green roofs. Trees frame the scene on the right and lower left. There is no visible printed text on the front.
